messages:
marie: quick sync — last night's incident RCA draft is up, I extracted action items and assigned tentative owners. Can everyone confirm they can take ownership and a due date? doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/rca/INC-523

jonah: I'll own A2 (autoscale policy fix). Target EOD Thu 2026-03-19. Need @eng-infra to review the terraform change, @sree can you review the runtime config?

sree: @jonah I can review the runtime change by tomorrow AM. infra review pinged: PR 3421 https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/3421 — needs a small change (region tags).

kate: I'll pick up A1 (KV-prefix cache TTL tuning + test). ETA Fri 2026-03-20. I'll post a short perf test in #eng-runtime once done.

alex: For A3 (canary rollback policy), I can draft the fallback policy but need product signoff. @marie can you loop in @pm? I can have a draft by Wed.

incident-bot: Reminder: INC-523 action items due in 72 hours: A1@kate, A2@jonah, A3@alex.

marie: thanks — two cross-team blockers: 1) infra PR merge (jonah) 2) prod signoff for rollback (alex). If either slips, fallback is to increase capacity on Dedicated tier and enable permissive routing — @ops please confirm we can do a manual scale if needed.

jonah: infra PR is blocked by a small test flake, I'll remove the flaky assertion and retest. New PR will be up in ~2h.

sree: ack. I'll review when it's in. Also flag: performance test harness needs a newer model checkpoint; @research to upload latest checkpoint or I won't be able to fully validate A1.

kate: noted — if research can't get checkpoint before Fri I can run a smoke with the previous checkpoint and mark the test as 'partial'. Will that be acceptable? :thinking:

alex: Product okayed drafting the rollback policy; @marie please add @pm-sara to the thread for final signoff.

marie: added @pm-sara. Final ask: once you claim an action, update the RCA doc with owner + due date and drop the PR/links. I'll run a closure pass on Friday 12:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

jonah: claimed A2, PR link will be in the doc.

kate: claimed A1, will add test notes.

alex: claimed A3 draft; will include fallback playbook.

sree: claimed infra review. I'll add a small checklist for validation into the doc.

pm-sara: acknowledged, will review A3 by Thu EOD.

ops: we can manual-scale Dedicated up to +30% within 20 mins, ops-oncall ready to execute if you mark it as emergency.

marie: perfect. I'll do a status sweep on Friday 12:00 UTC and close out anything done. If anything is blocked before then, ping me here. Thanks all :tada:
